description: Committee proposes 2027 meeting schedule for Council.
Committee recommends City Council approve 2027 Deputy Mayor appointments.
Committee recommends exploring city-wide community benefits framework options.
Also recommends a report on existing community benefits.
Implementing a framework requires new budget and staff.

chips.text: Quint Development Corporation submitted comments on community benefit frameworks.
Administration has no further work planned on a general framework without Council direction.
Timing and resources needed for a comprehensive report remain unclear.
Saskatchewan lacks legislative authority for mandatory development community benefits.
Saskatoon Poverty Reduction Partnership submitted comments on frameworks.

description: Administration to research options for regulating graphic flyer distribution.
Responds to graphic anti-abortion flyers delivered in August 2026.

chips.text: Children, pregnant women, and those with PTSD were distressed by graphic flyers.
Over 3,200 residents signed petitions opposing graphic flyer distribution.

speakers.name: Angie Kells of SASN
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Cllr B. Dubois – Regulation of Flyer Distr to Res Prop
said: Petition signed by 3,200 residents against graphic, disturbing, false pamphlets.
Pamphlets traumatized children and vulnerable people; abortion is a human right.
Bylaws can protect residents, supported by other cities and advertising standards.
